subject: MBAR options causing error in reading namelist cntrl

messages.author: Charlie Holdship
messages.body:
Hi Amber community,
I have been trying to run some TI simulations on peptide side-chain mutations and although they run fine normally and I can get dV/dl I would ideally like to use MBAR to calculate my free energy changes.
However, when I add the MBAR options from the manual to the end of my input file all I get back is the error in reading namelist control.
Here are the options that I am specifying in my input file:
imin = 0, nstlim = 2500000, irest = 1, ntx = 5, dt = 0.002,
ntt = 3, temp0 = 298.0, gamma_ln = 2.0, ig = -1,
ntc = 2, ntf = 1,
ntb = 2,
ntp = 1, pres0 = 1.0, taup = 2.0,
ioutfm = 1, iwrap = 1,
ntwe = 1000, ntwx = 1000, ntpr = 10000, ntwr = 20000, ntave = 50000,
icfe = 1, ifsc = 1, clambda = %L%, scalpha = 0.5, scbeta = 12.0,
logdvdl = 1,
scmask = ':211',
ifmbar = 1,
mbar_states = 15,
mbar_lambda = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99,
/
&ewald
/
Any help in identifying which of these settings are wrong/what I need to add to get this to work would be greatly appreciated.
Thanks,
Charlie

messages.author: Timothy Giese
messages.body: The MBAR print options are slightly different between pmemd and sander. When using sander, you can use the options: ifmbar, bar_intervall, bar_l_min, bar_l_max, bar_l_incr. When using pmemd, you can use the options ifmbar, bar_intervall, mbar_states, mbar_lambda. It looks like you used the pmemd-like options; this may result in an error when using sander.

messages.author: Charlie Holdship
messages.body:
Thank you this worked and my simulations are now running. This was helpful but it is in no way clear in the manual that these options should be used as it specifically states that they are deprecated and will not work. Should this not be updated for future users to not run into the same problem?
Thanks,
Charlie
